title: Mike Kelley: 99.9998% Remaining

description.main: A catalogue edited by Harald Falckenberg documenting Mike Kelley's exhibitions from 1982 to 2011, published by Walther König with The Watermill Center in 2012.
description.extended:
A catalogue of Mike Kelley's exhibition history from 1982 to 2011, issued after his death in January 2012.

Harald Falckenberg, a major collector of Kelley's work, edited the book and wrote its essay. Verlag der Buchhandlung Walther König published it with The Watermill Center, and it accompanied a tribute exhibition with the LUMA Foundation at the 19th Annual Watermill Center Summer Benefit on Long Island, July 28 to September 16, 2012. The 94-page paperback documents his major exhibitions, reproduces key works from different periods, and includes stills from videos such as Banana Man, Heidi and Sir Drone. The essay outlines Kelley's developmental periods and the art market's influence on his production.

The exhibition history includes the Arenas series, first shown at Metro Pictures in 1990. The video stills cover Kelley's collaborations with Paul McCarthy, Tony Oursler and Raymond Pettibon.
